# Nbt

*Common*

Common methods of the NBT values of scripts, [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) and [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList).

## Methods

### isCompound {#iscompound}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this is a compound (named values)

:::

### isList {#islist}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this is a list (indexed values of one type)

:::

### stringify {#stringify}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the value as SNBT text, like `{Health:20.0f,Tags:["boss"]}`, which `scram.compound` reads back

:::

### isEmpty {#isempty}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether it holds no values

:::

### size {#size}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — number of values it holds

:::

### copy {#copy}

::: member

**Returns** [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) — deep copy; changing it does not change this one

:::

### combine {#combine}

::: member

Copies the values of another NBT value of the same kind into this one: a compound takes over all keys of the other one, a list adds copies of its items if both hold the same type. Other combinations do nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) | NBT value to copy from |

:::

### isSame {#issame}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) | other NBT value, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both hold equal values of the same kind

:::
